ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE AMD is looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build the next generation of integrated marketing technology capabilities. As part of a new, collaborative software development team, you will design, build, and deliver applications, automation, and integrations that solve meaningful marketing and business problems. This is a hands-on engineering role with meaningful ownership. You will contribute to technology solutions across campaign workflows, testing, analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, user experiences, and integrations with existing marketing systems. THE PERSON You are a strong software engineer and practical problem solver who enjoys building new products and working across the technology stack. You are comfortable taking ownership of a defined portion of a larger product or initiative, solving complex technical problems, and turning requirements into reliable production solutions. You work effectively with engineers, product and program leaders, and business partners. You are curious about emerging technologies, including AI, and understand how to apply them thoughtfully to practical problems. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design, develop, test, deploy, and support full-stack software applications and services. Own defined components or features from technical design through production delivery. Build scalable applications, automation, APIs, user experiences, and integrations supporting marketing workflows. Solve complex technical problems and implement important architecture and design decisions within assigned areas. Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Technical Program Management, Marketing, Creative, Data, and other partner teams. Translate business needs into reliable and maintainable technical solutions. Apply AI and automation where they can improve workflows, capabilities, or user experiences. Contribute to software quality, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability. Participate in technical design, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement of engineering practices. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience designing, developing, and operating production software applications. Strong full-stack development experience across back-end systems and user-facing applications. Strong software-engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, APIs, system design, testing, and modern development practices. Experience owning and delivering meaningful components or features within larger software products. Experience developing applications, automation, integrations, analytics, or data-driven products. Practical experience with AI/ML, automation, or AI-assisted software development. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working effectively across technical and nontechnical teams. Experience with MarTech, AdTech, e-commerce, creative technology, customer-facing platforms, or another integration-heavy environment is a plus. ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. #LI-MM2 Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
